meta.title: A late bid that does not reach the top rank does not extend
gaps: The available wait operation cannot pause inside the last minute; the bid is not verified as late.
The vocabulary provides no read-back token for the first ending_at value, so the post-bid ending_at cannot be compared with its prior value to prove it was unchanged.
warnings: verify 2: read_indicators's reply shape has not been sampled; "auction_identifiers_data.{{vendor2Uuid}}.inline.{{lineItemUuid}}.rank" is unverified

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live pricing round.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid of 10 (open, price, submit).
A second QA vendor places a complete bid of 20 (open, price, submit).
The buyer reads the pricing round.
A second QA vendor prices the line on the bid at 15.
A second QA vendor submits the bid.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the read succeeds; “ending at” is a Unix timestamp in seconds.
As the buyer, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank” is at least 2.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the read succeeds; “ending at” is a Unix timestamp in seconds; “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank” is at least 2.
